description: Comprehensive mapping of chemical elements to their available orbitals for Hubbard DFT+U corrections

notes.version_2_improvements: Added complete periodic table coverage (H-Og), multiple orbitals per element, and higher orbital shells
notes.transition_metals_3d: Sc-Zn: 3d and 4s orbitals are typically available for Hubbard corrections
notes.transition_metals_4d: Y-Cd: 4d and 5s orbitals are typically available for Hubbard corrections
notes.transition_metals_5d: Hf-Hg: 5d and 6s orbitals are typically available for Hubbard corrections
notes.lanthanides: La-Lu: 4f, 5d, and 6s orbitals are typically available for Hubbard corrections
notes.actinides: Ac-Lr: 5f, 6d, and 7s orbitals are typically available for Hubbard corrections
notes.main_group: p-block elements: np orbitals are typically available (n=2-7)
notes.alkali_alkaline: s-block elements: ns orbitals may be available but are less common for Hubbard
notes.superheavy_elements: Elements 104-118: Limited data available, based on theoretical predictions
notes.orbital_hierarchy: For each element, orbitals are listed in order of typical importance for Hubbard corrections
notes.pseudopotential_dependent: Actual available orbitals depend on the specific pseudopotential used. This provides comprehensive defaults based on atomic physics.
